description: Open an interactive 3D replay of a run: a runner follows the GPS track over the terrain while pace, heart rate (zones), cadence, elevation/grade, power, running dynamics and weather play back over time, with pause, fast-forward and scrubbing. Use when the user wants to replay, relive, watch or review a run as a whole. Returns a short summary of the run; the view renders the time series.

activityId.description: Garmin activity ID (default: the most recent run)

name: show-run-replay
title: Show Run Replay
